listing.title: Mi LED 32" Smart Android LED TV
listing.description: Mi 32 inch smart android led tv. Working condition, no issues. Selling because moving out of city. Price negotiable.

priceAnomaly.note: Price is about 8% of the typical range for tvs — implausibly low for the stated item.

redFlags.label: Implausibly Low Price
redFlags.explanation: The listed price is significantly below market value for a 32" smart Android TV, indicating a potential scam.

redFlags.label: Insufficient Photos
redFlags.explanation: Only one photo is provided, limiting the ability to verify the item's condition and authenticity.

parsedVerdict.summary: The listing shows a price that is unusually low for the described TV and provides only a single photo, both of which are common red flags for scams. The seller appears to be an established account, which reduces but does not eliminate risk. No urgency or off‑platform payment language is present. Overall, the risk level is moderate to high.
checklistAdditions: Ask for additional photos from multiple angles, including a close‑up of the serial number; request a live video call to see the TV in operation; verify the serial number with the manufacturer; and arrange to meet in a public place to inspect the TV before payment.

matchedPatterns.label: Told to scan or approve to receive money
matchedPatterns.explanation: Scanning a QR code or approving a payment request can only ever send money, never receive it — there is no legitimate UPI flow where scanning brings money in.

paymentCheck.coreFact: A QR code or payment request can only ever be used to send money, never to receive it. If anyone — no matter how convincing — asks you to scan something or enter your PIN/OTP to 'receive' a payment, that is always false, with no exceptions.
paymentCheck.summary: This matches patterns used in marketplace payment fraud. Do not scan anything, do not approve any payment request, and do not share any PIN, OTP, or CVV — no matter what the other person says.
